name: Jinako Carigiri
source:
Jinako Carigiri is the Master of Karna in the Holy Grail War of the Moon Cell in Fate/Extra CCC. 

[spoiler]She summons Karna as a Lancer class during the Holy Grail War on the Near Side, however she changes his class name to Launcher due to Brahmastra appearing similar to a beam attack.[/spoiler]
translation:
Jinako Carigiri is the Master of Karna in the Holy Grail War of the Moon Cell in Fate/Extra CCC. 

[spoiler]She summons Karna as a Lancer class during the Holy Grail War on the Near Side, however she changes his class name to Launcher due to Brahmastra appearing similar to a beam attack.[/spoiler]
